title: Lathe Phase 12 Kit Part
description: Internal JSON schema for a single Phase 12 hard-surface kit-part data file. NOT a public .lth syntax. Used by lathe.asset_quality.kit_library.load_kit_library to validate per-part metadata files under std/kits/hardsurface/<category>/.

name.description: Globally unique kit-part identifier within the kit library.

category.description: MVP kit-part category. Phase 12 ships exactly five categories.

kind.description: Authoring kind. Phase 12 ships only `procedural` parts; `mesh_stub` is reserved for future phases when stub mesh files are introduced.

procedural_recipe.description: Free-form recipe descriptor (only required when kind == 'procedural'). The schema does not validate the recipe internals beyond 'is an object' to keep authoring flexible.

mesh_stub_uri.description: Relative path to a mesh-stub file under std/kits/hardsurface/ (only required when kind == 'mesh_stub'). NO real meshes ship in Phase 12.

preview_thumbnail.description: Optional thumbnail URI for authoring previews. When omitted, the loader emits a deterministic kit://hardsurface/<category>/<name>/preview_thumbnail fallback in metadata.

material_zones.description: Names of material zones the part exposes (e.g. 'painted_steel_body', 'warning_label_yellow'). Strings should align with the Phase 8 material/wear graph zone vocabulary where possible.

sockets.description: List of attachment sockets. Empty array is allowed.

anchor_axis.description: Primary axis the socket anchors to.

default_position.description: Default [x, y, z] position in part-local coordinates.

placement_constraints.description: Where the part may be placed on a host surface.

scale_range.description: Allowed scale multipliers for the part. Both > 0; max >= min.

allowed_families.description: List of family names the part is allowed on. ['*'] means all families.

lod_behavior.description: How the part participates in LOD chains.

provenance.description: Provenance record for the part data.
